policy: Preserve the historical Lee reference columns. Alternative experimental evidence is assessed separately for all methods on identical populations, never chosen to improve a preferred method.

Lee2021.table: Table 1, ten local/semilocal functionals, 43 materials of which 36 have an experimental entry
Lee2021.edition_review: The institutional deposit links the author manuscript to the published DOI. Publisher-typeset version-of-record table identity has not been verified.
Lee2021.protocol: Experimental geometries, GTH-LDA and unc-def2-QZVP. Native UZH/PBE-GTH results do not reproduce the same basis/core protocol.

Lee2022.table: Table AII, truncated-Coulomb band gaps for 25 materials and twelve hybrid functionals; not Table AI Madelung-only gaps
Lee2022.edition_review: The institutional deposit links the author manuscript to the published DOI. Publisher-typeset version-of-record table identity has not been verified.
Lee2022.protocol: GTH-PBE, unc-def2-QZVP, Madelung-corrected SCF and truncated-Coulomb band evaluation. Population and finite-size treatment differ from Lee2021 and the native calculations.

reference_chain.location: Heyd et al. 2005, Section II, Table I and Table V
reference_chain.verified_qualification: The SC/40 compilation includes alloy-extrapolated experimental entries and uses weighted spin-orbit averages when known to approximate scalar-relativistic gaps. It is not a uniform set of raw optical onsets measured at one temperature.
reference_chain.restriction: Do not infer an identical spin-orbit correction for every Lee entry without checking its individual source. No temperature or transition assignment is invented.

targeted_source_leads.BAs: Wentzcovitch and Cohen, J. Phys. C 19, 6791 (1986), an intermediate theoretical source for the historical value

BAs.temperature: room temperature, explicitly stated for the absorption spectra
BAs.measurement: Indirect Tauc extrapolation from UV-visible absorption of three single crystals
BAs.verified_location: Page 5 paragraph preceding Figure 1, Figure 1(a) on page 6
BAs.distinction: The 1.82 eV absorption estimate is distinct from the approximately 1.72 eV band-edge photoluminescence peak. The authors attribute a lower approximately 1.40 eV luminescence feature to defects.
BAs.treatment: Separate reference-sensitivity-20260923.json; no replacement of Lee's 1.46 eV column or primary statistics
BAs.limitations: No uniform zero-temperature, excitonic, spin-orbit or strain correction is established here. Native BAs AE has finite frontier energies but explicitly censored deep-core band output.

MgO.historical_chain: Lee2021 follows the SC/40 compilation. Heyd Table V already contains 7.22 eV; a Lee-specific transcription error has not been established.
MgO.verified_location: Original PDF, Table I on page 10337, with the MgO discussion and Figure 7 on page 10331; Table I visually checked.
MgO.primary_interpretation: Table I gives the EELS fit alongside a 7.8 eV literature value. The quoted uncertainty derives from correlation-peak localization, not a complete systematic uncertainty. Measurement temperature was not established.
MgO.alternative_reference_lead: 10.1016/0038-1098(73)90754-0, Whited, Flaten and Walker, Exciton thermoreflectance of MgO and CaO
MgO.status: The historical 7.22 eV value is verified in the original experimental paper, not an established transcription error. Its physical difference from the optical reference remains unresolved. The original Whited numeric 7.83 eV extraction remains unverified. Preserve the explicit sensitivity without conflating the measurements.

MgTe.measurement_scope: Inferred from structural and optical analysis of CdTe/MgTe heterostructures, not established here as an independent unstrained-bulk fundamental-gap measurement.
MgTe.status: The publisher abstract now independently verifies the value and temperature. Full text was not obtained. Lee's 3.6 eV remains unchanged, with no alternative sensitivity generated.
MgTe.next_check: Resolve the relation of the heterostructure estimate to Lee's value, including temperature, strain and reference conventions, without assuming a transcription error.

MgS.verified_location: Page 113203-3, final paragraph of Section V, visually checked in the original publisher PDF.
MgS.measurement_scope: Estimated 5 K gap, inferred from room-temperature Raman resonance near 5.1 eV and an assumed ZnS-like temperature shift. The authors explicitly distinguish this inference from a direct gap measurement.
MgS.treatment: Keep Lee's 5.4 eV historical entry. No replacement, numerical sensitivity or new calculation. The SI now qualifies the temperature and indirect measurement method.

Ba_chalcogenides.verified_location: Table I, page 115, and interpretation on page 118 visually checked. Measurement conditions are described on page 114.
Ba_chalcogenides.measurement_scope: The Lee entries match the first absorption peaks in annealed films. Zollweg interprets them as excitonic, not established fundamental band-to-band thresholds.
Ba_chalcogenides.treatment: Preserve historical values and statistics. No invented exciton or spin-orbit correction. The SI now explicitly qualifies the optical observable and temperature.

BN.verified_location: Table I, page 10337, cubic BN row visually checked in the original publisher PDF.
BN.qualification: EELS correlation-fit uncertainty is not a complete systematic error bound. Temperature remains unverified. Both native sampled BN minima are indirect; this agreement does not prove basis/k or electronic-state convergence.
BN.treatment: Historical value unchanged. Independent source confirmation only, no new table or reference sensitivity.

band_edge_interpretation_review.reporting_rule: D for direct-minus-minimum splitting below 1e-6 eV, N from 1e-6 to below 1e-3 eV, I at least 1e-3 eV. These are reporting conventions, not validated error bounds or experimental transition assignments.

LiH_AE.geometry_check: Frozen LiH input has equal cell lengths and 60-degree angles, with Li at 0,0,0 and H at 0.5,0.5,0.5. Swapping fractional axes 2 and 3 leaves its lattice metric and species positions invariant and exchanges these X-star points.
LiH_AE.correction: Table S45 I becomes N. Do not infer physical indirect character from this numerical splitting. Gap value and statistics unchanged.

MgS_AE.interpretation: Sampled indirect AE versus direct GAPW-XC/GTH, as also observed for Ge. Now explicitly discussed in SI; no protocol selected by experimental closeness.

band_edge_interpretation_review.validation: All 33 paper tests pass, including threshold boundaries, invalid inputs, unique LiH near-degeneracy and generated-table label. Full scalar gap/reference/statistical data remain unchanged.

MgSe.status: Partial citation-chain audit, not verified experimental-source acceptance

verified_chain.Heyd2005: Author-uploaded full text, Table I assigns B1 cubic MgSe to reference 62. Table V lists 2.47 eV in the experimental column. Reference 62 is D. Rached et al., physica status solidi (b) 240, 565-573 (2003).
verified_chain.Rached2003_verified_scope: Publisher abstract identifies an FP-LMTO theoretical study of B1, B3 and B4 MgS/MgSe. Its reference list includes Strehlow and Cook 1973 as reference 33. The original numerical MgSe table and its footnotes have not yet been independently inspected.
verified_chain.access_limit: Publisher full/epdf unavailable. The ResearchGate page has two author uploads, but its default extracted full text and accessible first PDF are the different Sr-chalcogenide article, DOI 10.1002/pssb.200402053. They must not be treated as the MgSe source. On 23 September around 11:09 UTC, a single ordinary browser visit to the previously located original-table page encountered an explicit DataDome blocked/CAPTCHA page. The tab was closed without interacting with the challenge. Do not repeat blocked retrievals without changed access or a legitimately supplied copy. No access-control bypass was attempted.

cross_check_not_yet_linked_to_2_47.title: Compilation of Energy Band Gaps in Elemental and Binary Compound Semiconductors and Insulators
cross_check_not_yet_linked_to_2_47.authors: W. H. Strehlow and E. L. Cook
cross_check_not_yet_linked_to_2_47.visual_check: Printed page 167, entries 128-130 list MgSe values 5.6 eV at 70 K (reference 546), 5.63 eV at 90 K (reference 451), and 5.6 eV at 300 K (reference 126). These entries do not establish the origin or validity of Lee's 2.47 eV value. Their phase and measurement interpretation were not established in this check.
cross_check_not_yet_linked_to_2_47.restriction: Do not substitute these compilation values for Lee's value or infer a specific error in the Lee/Heyd reference without examining the intermediate table and original experimental sources.

MgSe.next_check: Inspect the actual Rached2003 MgSe band-gap table and footnotes, distinguish calculated versus experimental columns and B1 versus B3 phases, then trace the cited original measurement if available.
MgSe.treatment: No gap, reference, selected population, statistic or manuscript change. No new sensitivity or exclusion. Historical 2.47 eV retained. This unresolved lead does not justify relaunching any calculation.

separate_sensitivity_validation.tests: Six reference-sensitivity tests and three existing terminal-audit tests passed.
separate_sensitivity_validation.interpretation: The small Skala/HSE MAE ordering changes with this one reference. Neither ordering establishes robust superiority. Pure-AE subsets, signed means, RMSE, maxima and all other comparator statistics remain separately available in the sensitivity artifact.
